svg.title: Test stand. Eight gauges, one per kind of work: Defence video intelligence: 70% less analyst intervention (under 200 ms, ingestion to decision); Multi-tenant health AI: 8,000+ approved columns, reportable (193 tables · 100+ prompts retired); Restaurant operations: 32% less food waste (validated across 200+ restaurants); Event pipelines: 2M+ events a day (each one under 100 ms); Agentic finance: 60% fewer manual touchpoints (risk, rebalancing, onboarding); Fine-tuned health models: 80% lower inference cost (94% precision · p95 under 800 ms); Insurance documents: 95%+ extraction accuracy (underwriting efficiency up 78%); Clinical NLP: 91.5% accuracy on 47+ variables (5K+ health records a day).
svg.text: TEST STAND · EIGHT ENGAGEMENTS, ONE READING EACH
Every needle stops at a number from the record below.
THRUST STAND · EIGHT CHANNELS, ONE PER ENGAGEMENT
Readings are from the work itself, each with a results file or a case study behind it. Dial ends are labelled; nothing is a score.
